review_candidates.title: Systems Engineer / System Administrator for Managed Service Provider
review_candidates.description_excerpt: More specifically, we need a System Administrator that is Humble, Hungry, and Smart! We are looking for a Systems Engineer to help build out, maintain, and troubleshoot our clients rapidly expanding infrastructure. Essential Responsibilities include but not limited to: Analyzes problems from a systems perspective, isolates to hardware or software issue and carries through to resolution Provides IT support relating to technical issues involving Microsoft's core business applications / Azure / Off
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Essential Responsibilities include but not limited to: Analyzes problems from a systems perspective, isolates to hardware or software issue and carries through to resolution Provides IT support relating to technical issues involving Microsoft's core business applications / Azure / Office 365, as well as virtual environments built on Hyper-V Support services for Microsoft related technologies: Windows Server, Azure, Exchange, SQL, SharePoint, etc Implement and support disaster recovery solutions Technical services and support at the network level: WAN and LAN connectivity, routers, firewalls, and security Remote access solution implementation and support: VPN, Remote Desktop / Terminal Services, and Azure Virtual Desktop System documentation to include system reviews and recommendations Travels to customer sites to perform work when appropriate (company vehicle provided) Maintains familia
